slice_contract.real_problem: M33 proved deterministic retry safety and M34 proved client feedback under controlled faults, but only one successful official request has exercised the retained production path. DSE does not yet know the current official service's natural latency distribution, transient failure frequency, safe-retry recovery rate, partial-response incidence or whether the stored failure facts remain complete in independent real Agent Runs.
acceptance: run one immutable dse/dse-tui binary pair through the canonical AgentApplication -> AgentRuntime -> RunStore path
use only official OpenAI-format DeepSeek ChatCompletions with deepseek-v4-pro/high
interleave four task profiles for six fresh rounds, twenty-four independent Runs total
enable the normal product max_model_retries=2; transport hidden retries remain zero
record every physical started/completed/in-flight attempt, Runtime retry, failure category, retry/stop decision, latency, terminal, external verifier, usage/cache/cost and billing status
prove credential-free SQLite reopen and exact event-prefix/accounting replay after every Run
stop before the next paid Run on billing_unknown, usage_incomplete, identity mismatch, unsafe evidence, observer ambiguity or any unsealed/in-flight request
admit a production treatment only when the same stable owner_code:loss_code repeats across at least two different task profiles or two independent rounds

slice_contract.candidate_deletion: the temporary M35 Harness consumer is deleted after the decision; if no repeated live loss exists, production code remains byte-unchanged
forbidden: attacking or deliberately rate-limiting the official DeepSeek service
Harness-level logical Run reruns, mate completion or selective resampling
transport retries, infinite reconnect, blind partial-response replay or fake SSE continuation
changing model, reasoning, permission, prompt, tool catalog or task after acquisition begins
Auto, Anthropic Messages, a second Provider/Runtime/Store/controller or fallback model
printing, logging, persisting or committing the credential

decision_rule.no_treatment: complete the available schedule or stop at the first formal accounting/safety boundary; if no stable owner_code:loss_code repeats, record no_repeated_live_reliability_loss and leave production unchanged
decision_rule.treatment_admission: only one smallest unique-owner treatment may be implemented after the same cause repeats across independent real Runs; rerun a fresh successor schedule from position 1 rather than editing or continuing frozen raw
decision_rule.keep: the treatment must remove the repeated loss while preserving partial/in-flight fail-closed behavior, false_success=0, exact reopen, complete accounting and one Runtime retry owner
decision_rule.reject: delete the treatment and keep M33/M34 behavior if it fails any safety, replay, accounting, surface or complexity gate
